correctness.rationale: Exact recurrence and explicit backtracking both enumerate 288 perfect matchings of the 30-vertex, 45-edge duad–syntheme graph. All complementary 2-factors are traversed, giving 144 of type (30) and 144 of type (10,20). A logically distinct C++ bijection-and-bitmask implementation confirms the same counts and all 144 partitions of the edge set into three perfect matchings. Six maximal duad stars bound bipartition-preserving automorphisms by 720; all 720 occur from S6, and a checked explicit duality yields 1440. Exact permutation application proves one orbit on factorizations (size 144), so a checked representative proves every coloring has exactly one Hamiltonian bichromatic cycle. These computations are finite exhaustive, not samples; external independent auditing is not performed.

value.rationale: The complete classification of three-edge-colorings of the classical Tutte–Coxeter cage describes forced patterns of all bichromatic spanning 2-factors, not merely a matching count. It establishes the structurally restrictive phenomenon of exactly one Hamiltonian color pair and full equivalence under graph symmetries. These exact, natural graph-factorization invariants provide a reproducible baseline for bipartite cubic geometry and edge-coloring studies, with no unsupported generalization.
